seo.title: DQ File Audit Software for Trucking Fleets | deltaV
seo.description: Audit driver qualification files against your own checklist. Every Yes, No or Missing comes with the page behind it, so files get fixed before a DOT audit.
faq: Does it replace our DQ file software?
No. It checks the files you already keep, in folders or scanned PDFs, and fills in the audit sheet you already use.
Does it decide whether we are compliant?
No. It flags what is missing, expired or unsigned and shows the page. A person makes the call on every item.
What about driver data like license numbers?
Data handling is agreed during scoping and the system runs where your compliance requires.
